first violating step, centre beyond arena+radius+tolerance, overshoot 0.159 >0.15

counterfactual.change: Reduced initial vx from 13.718 to 5.0; with same dt, steps, gravity, radius, the body remains inside arena for full 140 steps, so no in_arena violation.

explanation: Shrunk scenario has a single body with high horizontal velocity (13.7 m/s) and no walls. It moves ballistically under gravity and crosses the right arena boundary. At step 139 it is still within tolerance (overshoot 0.058), at step 140 it exceeds 0.15 (overshoot 0.159). There is no implicit boundary wall collision to stop it, so in_arena is violated. Reducing vx prevents escape within the 140 steps, confirming velocity/position bound is the cause.
vision_note: The red violating body moves rightward and slightly downward across the frames, approaching the right edge of the arena from step 138 to 139. At step 140 it appears at the bottom-right corner crossing outside the arena bounds, with no walls present to stop it.
